ISSUE-003 instead concerns whether the selected grid point is a global near-maximizer and whether the supremum over continuous time is defined; it does not recognize the distinct time-step error mismatch.

The gold defect concerns a cutoff that equals one only on the unit Euclidean ball, which does not contain the cube in dimensions d>=2, so equality of the cutoff-modified and original functions on the cube fails. ISSUE-002 diagnoses the separate uniform-domain-neighborhood defect in Lemma 4.11 and does not recognize the cutoff support or interpolation-data failure.

Both entries identify that shifts of size delta^(1/2-theta) cannot remain inside an arbitrary open set uniformly for every x because points may approach the boundary; choosing delta_1 after x proves only a localized statement, not the asserted uniform one.
